note: Hand-edited list of club events. Times are ISO 8601 with offset. Run `npm run ics` (or any build) after editing to refresh the calendar files.

events.title: Parkrun + coffee

location.name: Tonbridge parkrun, lower castle car park

events.description: 5k at whatever pace you like, then coffee by the castle. Bring your barcode.

events.title: Sunday social ride
events.description: No-drop loop out through Penshurst and back via Hildenborough. Cafe stop at halfway. Lights and a spare tube, please.

events.title: Midweek towpath tempo
events.description: Warm-up, 3 x 10 minutes at tempo, cool-down. Head torch essential.

events.title: Festive hike to Penshurst
events.description: Easy-going walk across the fields to Penshurst Place and back, with a pub lunch. Mud likely.
